y-m-30-05.prereq.0: Huwandu hwemakona mana echimiro chine mativi mana ndi360°
y-m-30-05.title: Rombhasi inogara yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa here?
y-m-30-05.topic: Huwandu hwemakona akatarisana ekwadhirateri yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa
y-m-30-05.goal: Shandisa chokwadi chokuti huwandu hwemakona maviri akatarisana ekwadhirateri yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa ndi 180° sechiyero chokutarisa kutenda kwokuti 'rombhasi inogara yakanyorwa', uye ugadzire seti dzakati wandei dzemakona mana ekwadhirateri anosangana nemamiriro.
y-m-30-05.material: Kwadhirateri ine mapoinzi ayo mana ose padenderedzwa rimwe inonzi 'kwadhirateri yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa'. Mukwadhirateri yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa, huwandu hwehukuru hwemakona maviri akatarisana ndi 180°. Jiho anofunga, 'Rombhasi, ine mativi ayo mana ose akaenzana, inogara yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa.' (Murombhasi, makona akatarisana akaenzana muhukuru.)
y-m-30-05.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemipimo (huwandu hwemakona akatarisana, kwete pararerogiramu)
y-m-30-05.thinking.2: Kutsvaga nyaya yakakosha apo chirevo chinoshanda
y-m-30-05.prereq.2: Hunhu hwokuti huwandu hwemakona maviri akatarisana ekwadhirateri yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa ndi 180° (fungidzira kuti unogona kushandiswa mubasa iri)
y-m-30-05.s.s1.prompt: Pane rombhasi ABCD ine ∠A = 70°. Rombhasi iyi inogona kunyorwa mudenderedzwa here?
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti hukama hupi hunofanira kuvapo pakati pemakona akatarisana kana kwadhirateri yakanyorwa.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga hukuru hwekona inotarisana ne ∠A murombhasi iyi, uye utarise kana hukama hwepamusoro huchishanda.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.a: Yakanyorwa. Mativi mana akaenzana, saka mapoinzi mana ari pamudenderedzwa
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.a: Funga kana kuva nekureba kwemativi kwakaenzana nokuva nemapoinzi ari padenderedzwa rimwe chinhu chimwe chete.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.b: Haina kunyorwa. Huwandu hwe ∠A nekona yayo inotarisana ∠C ndi 140°
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakatarisa kana huwandu hwemakona maviri akatarisana ndi 180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.c: Yakanyorwa. Nokuti huwandu hwemakona mana ndi 360°
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.c: Huwandu hwemakona mana ndi 360° mukwadhirateri yega yega. Funga kana ichiri chiyero chingasarudza kana yakanyorwa.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.d: Funga kana unogona kutonga kunyange peya imwe yemakona akatarisana isiri 180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.explain: Murombhasi, ∠C = ∠A = 70°, saka ∠A + ∠C = 140° ≠ 180°. Dai yakanyorwa, huwandu hwemakona maviri akatarisana waifanira kuva 180°, asi hausi, saka rombhasi iyi haina kunyorwa mudenderedzwa.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira seti 3 dzakasiyana dzehukuru hwemakona mana (mumadhigirii, nhamba dzizere) ekwadhirateri ABCD yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa isiri pararerogiramu. Makona akatarisana ndi A ne C, uye B ne D. (Dzinosiyana nokuronga chete dzinoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.)
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza ∠A, wobva wasarudza ∠C. Pane hukama pakati pemakona akatarisana here?
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza ∠B ne ∠D nenzira imwe chete, wobva watarisa huwandu hwemakona mana uye kuti ∠A ne ∠C hazvienzani.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Makona ose mana inhamba dzizere dziri pamusoro.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Makona ose mana anofanira kuva nhamba dzizere (mumadhigirii) dzakakura kupfuura 0.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Huwandu hwepeya yega yega yemakona akatarisana ndi 180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwemakona akatarisana (A ne C, B ne D) hausi 180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Makona akatarisana akasiyana, saka haisi pararerogiramu.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Kana ∠A ne ∠C zvakaenzana, ingava pararerogiramu. Ita kuti zvisiyane.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaita huwandu hwe ∠A ne ∠C nehuwandu hwe ∠B ne ∠D rimwe nerimwe 180°, huwandu hwemakona mana hunova 360° pachahwo. Chero bedzi ∠A ≠ ∠C, haisi pararerogiramu. (70°, 80°, 110°, 100°) ne (60°, 90°, 120°, 90°) mienzaniso.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.prompt: Kana paine rombhasi umo pfungwa yaJiho 'rombhasi inogara yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa' yakarurama, ingava rombhasi yakaita sei? Nyorawo chikonzero.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ti kona imwe yerombhasi ive x, nyora kona inotarisana se x, uye unyore kuti huwandu hwemakona maviri hunofanira kuva nokukosha kupi.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko chimiro cherombhasi ine x iyoyo.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.placeholder: muenzaniso: Kana kona imwe iri x, ...
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa here chokwadi chokuti kana kona imwe yerombhasi iri x, kona inotarisana iri x zvakare?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti x inosarudzwa sei (2x = 180°)?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakajekesa here mhedziso yokuti hairi rombhasi yose?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.0: Sikweya. Kana kona imwe iri 90°, huwandu hwemakona akatarisana ndi 90°+90°=180°, saka inogona kunyorwa mudenderedzwa.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.1: Rombhasi ine makona ose akarurama chete, ndiko kuti, sikweya, ndiyo inogoneka. Makona akatarisana erombhasi akaenzana, saka kana kona imwe iri x, 2x=180°, saka x=90°.

y-m-30-04.title: Kona inoona diameter AB inogara iri 90° chero poinzi C iri kupi here?
y-m-30-04.goal: Dzidza kuti 'inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu i90°' hunhu hwekana poinzi C iri padenderedzwa, uye ushandise mienzaniso yawakagadzira wega kuongorora uye utaure kuti chii chinochinja kana poinzi iri mukati kana kunze kwedenderedzwa ichiona kona imwe chete.
y-m-30-04.material: Pacoordinate plane, pakati pedenderedzwa O iorigin uye migumo miviri yediameter AB i A(−5, 0) ne B(5, 0). Radius yedenderedzwa i5, uye poinzi C iri panzvimbo apo y-coordinate iri huru kupfuura 0. Hyejin akashandisa chokwadi chekuti 'inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu i90°' kutaura, '∠ACB i90° chero poinzi C iri kupi.' (∠ACB inoverengwa se 'angle A C B'.)
y-m-30-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso inoita mamiriro kubva pamapoinzi ari mukati medenderedzwa
y-m-30-04.thinking.2: Kuwedzera mugumisiro kunyaya iri kunze kwedenderedzwa
y-m-30-04.prereq.0: Diameter yedenderedzwa nemainscribed angles (hunhu hwekuti inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu ikona yakarurama)
y-m-30-04.prereq.1: Nzvimbo yepoinzi pacoordinate plane nesquare yedaro pakati pemapoinzi maviri
y-m-30-04.prereq.2: Kushandisa Pythagorean theorem nekupesana kwayo kusarudza makona obtuse neacute
y-m-30-04.s.s1.prompt: Unogona kutaura chii zvino nezvechirevo chaHyejin?
y-m-30-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kubva mumashoko e 'inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu', wana kuti poinzi C inofanira kuva kupi.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi imwe isiri padenderedzwa (semuenzaniso poinzi iri padhuze pamusoro peorigin), ibatanidze neA neB, uye ufungidzire kana ∠ACB iri huru kana diki kupfuura kona yakarurama.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.a: Akarurama. Kana pane diameter AB, ∠ACB i90° chero C iri kupi
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.a: Fungidzira kana hunhu hwe 'inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu' ihunhu hunobata nzvimbo yakaiswa poinzi.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.b: Haana kururama. Hapana poinzi C chero kupi umo ∠ACB i90°
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.b: Fungidzira kana zvichienderana nehunhu hwatoziva hwepoinzi C iri padenderedzwa.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.c: Handisati ndaziva. Hunhu hwatakadzidza hunogona kushandiswa chete kana C iri padenderedzwa
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakafunga nezvemamiriro umo hunhu hunoshanda uye kwakafunga kuti kunze kwechiyero chekushandiswa kunoda kuongorora kwakawanda.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.d: Akarurama. Asi chete kana hurefu hweAC neBC hwakaenzana
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.d: Kana AC = BC, saka poinzi C iri pa y-axis. Fungidzira kana kona yakafanana papoinzi yega yega pariri.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.explain: Hunhu hwekuti inscribed angle padenderedzwa rehafu i90° hwunobata kana poinzi C iri padenderedzwa (poinzi isiri pakanga iri padiameter AB). Mapoinzi ari mukati kana kunze kwedenderedzwa anofanira kuongororwa wega.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mapoinzi C(x, y) ari mukati medenderedzwa ane x-coordinate ne y-coordinate zvose maintegers, uye ugadzire mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana umo ∠ACB iri huru kupfuura kona yakarurama (obtuse). Poinzi C ine y > 0 uye iri mukati medenderedzwa. (Mapoinzi maviri akaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi anoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.)
y-m-30-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza poinzi C, wana masquare ehurefu hweAC neBC, uye uenzanise huwandu hwazvo nesquare yeAB, 100.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ongorora nemapoinzi maviri kuti kuenzanisa kuri pamusoro kunosiyana sei kana square yedaro kubva kuorigin kusvika kuC iri pasi nepamusoro pesquare ye5.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c1: x ne y zvinofanira kuva maintegers.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Poinzi C inofanira kuva panzvimbo apo y > 0.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Poinzi C iri mukati medenderedzwa (∠ACB i obtuse).
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Poinzi C haipo mukati medenderedzwa. Ongorora kana square yedaro kubva kuorigin kusvika kuC iri pasi pe25.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana C(0, 1), saka AC² = 26 ne BC² = 26, uye huwandu i52, iri pasi peAB² = 100, saka ∠ACB i obtuse. C(3, 4) ipoinzi iri padenderedzwa, saka ikona yakarurama, uye C(4, 4) iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, saka AC² + BC² = 114 > 100, zvinoita kuti ive acute.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.prompt: Papoinzi C iri kunze kwedenderedzwa (y > 0), ∠ACB iri huru kana diki kupfuura 90°? Sarudza poinzi uye uongorore nenhamba, uye urongedze unyore kuti ∠ACB inochinja sei zvichienderana nenzvimbo yepoinzi C (mukati medenderedzwa, padenderedzwa, kunze kwedenderedzwa).
y-m-30-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza poinzi iri kunze kwedenderedzwa uye uite kuenzanisa kumwe chete sepa s2 (AC² + BC² ne AB²).
y-m-30-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora patafura kuti mhedzisiro yokuenzanisa uku inosiyana sei mukati medenderedzwa, padenderedzwa, nekunze kwedenderedzwa.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Papoinzi yandakasarudza, ndakaenzanisa zvakananga hukuru hwa AC², BC², ne AB² here?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura nyaya dzose nhatu here: mukati, padenderedzwa, nekunze kwedenderedzwa?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakataura mafambiro eshanduko here, se 'sezvo poinzi ichienda kure'?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.model.0: Kutarisa poinzi C(4, 4) iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, AC²=81+16=97, BC²=1+16=17, uye huwandu 114 hukuru kupfuura AB²=100, saka ∠ACB ikona yakapinza iri pasi pe 90°. Mukupfupisa, mukati medenderedzwa ikona yakapamhama, padenderedzwa ikona yakarurama, uye kunze kwedenderedzwa ikona yakapinza.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.model.1: Poinzi (6, 1) iri kunze kwedenderedzwa ine chinhambwe chakaitwa sikweya che 37 kubva ku origin, chakakura kupfuura 25. Wobva wava ∠ACB iri pasi pe 90°. Sezvo C ichienda kure na AB, kona inova diki, uye ndi 90° chaizvo padenderedzwa chete.

y-m-30-02.title: Kufungidzira hurefu hwepamuti wefuremu kubva pakona yekusimudzira ye35°
y-m-30-02.topic: Kushandisa trigonometric ratios (kuwana hurefu kubva pakona yekusimudzira)
y-m-30-02.goal: Dzidza kuti kona yekusimudzira yoga haisarudze hurefu, sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa zvakare, ongorora kuti hurefu hwemaziso hunofanira kuwedzerwa, uye fungidzira kuti kukanganisa mukuyera kona kunokanganisa sei mugumisiro.
y-m-30-02.material: Unoda kuwana hurefu hwepamuti wefuremu pachikoro paplayground. Pasi pakati sandara uye pamuti wefuremu pakamira perpendicular nepasi. Wakamira panzvimbo iri kure nepamuti wefuremu uchitarisa kumusoro kumusoro wayo, wakayera kona yekutarisa kumusoro (kona yekusimudzira) ndokuita 35°. Hauna kuyera zvimwe zvakakosha. Rejista: tan 35° inenge 0.7002, sin 35° inenge 0.5736, uye cos 35° inenge 0.8192. 'tan' inoverengwa se 'tangent'.
y-m-30-02.thinking.1: Kuwana musanganiswa wakasiyana weruzivo unotungamira kumugumisiro mumwe chete
y-m-30-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent) yekona mutriangle yakarurama
y-m-30-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga tebhura yekukosha kwetrigonometric ratios kana kushandisa kukosha kwakafungidzirwa kwakapiwa
y-m-30-02.s.s1.prompt: Wawana kona yekusimudzira ye35° chete. Unoda kuziva chii zvakare kuti usarudze hurefu hwepamuti wefuremu? Sarudza zvose zvinodiwa. (Pangava nemisanganiswa yakasiyana inokodzera.)
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura nemashoko triangle yakarurama inogadzirwa nekona yekusimudzira. Divi rega rega riri kubva papi kuenda kupi?
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.1: Pamativi etriangle iyoyo, paradzanisa awakatoziva neawakasingazive, uye uongororewo kana hurefu hunotanga pasi kana kumaziso.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.a: Daro rakachinjika remamita 20 kubva panowakamira kusvika pasi pepamuti wefuremu
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.a: Nedaro rakachinjika, pamwe chete nekona yekusimudzira, unogona kusarudza hurefu hwakakwira kubva kumaziso kusvika pamusoro.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.b: Daro rakananga kubva kumaziso kusvika pamusoro, rinenge 24.4 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.b: Daro rakananga, rakabatanidzwa nekona yekusimudzira, rinogonawo kusarudza hurefu. Zvisinei, zvakaoma kuriyera zvakananga.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.c: Hurefu kubva pasi kusvika kumaziso, 1.5 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana ukawana hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso chete, hausi hurefu hwekubva pasi kusvika pamusoro. Fungidzira kuti hurefu hwuri kubva papi kuenda kupi.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.d: Hukora ruzivo rusina chekuita nehurefu hwepamusoro. Fungidzira kana iri kureba kunopinda mutriangle inosarudza hurefu.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.explain: Kuwana hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso kubva pakona yekusimudzira, unoda imwe kureba (daro rakachinjika kana daro rakananga). Zvakare, hurefu uhwu hwuri kubva kumaziso kusvika pamusoro, saka kuwana hurefu kubva pasi kusvika pamusoro, unofanira kuwedzera hurefu hwemaziso.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.acc.0: Kunyange kana uchiziva daro rakananga kubva kumaziso kusvika pamusoro, pamwe chete nekona yekusimudzira unogona kusarudza hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso, wobva wawedzera hurefu hwemaziso. Zvisinei, zvakaoma kuyera daro rakananga zvakananga, saka kushandisa daro rakachinjika kunonyanya kuitika.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.prompt: Zvino wakayera daro rakachinjika remamita 20 nehurefu hwemaziso 1.5 m. Kukosha kupi kunokodzera zvikuru hurefu hwepamuti wefuremu? (tan 35° ≈ 0.7002)
y-m-30-02.s.s2.hint.0: Mutriangle yakarurama ine kona yekusimudzira sekona imwe, sarudza kana 20 m nehurefu hwaunoda kuwana zviri divi riri padivi pekona iyoyo uye divi riri pakatarisana nayo.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekuongorora kana hurefu hwawakawana huri kubva kumaziso kana pasi, gadzirisa nenzira inokodzera.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.a: Pangava pawakashandisa trigonometric ratio yakasiyana, nedaro rakachinjika sedivi riri padivi, kuwana hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso. Ongorora zvakare kuti ratio iri kubva kudivi ripi kuenda kudivi ripi.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.b: Pangava pawakawana hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso chete usina kuwedzera hurefu hwemaziso. Ongorora zvakare kwakatanga hurefu.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.c: Iyi mhinduro yakawana hurefu kubva paratio yedaro rakachinjika nehurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso ndokuwedzera hurefu hwemaziso.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.d: Pangava pawakashandisa trigonometric ratio isingaenderani nehukama pakati pedaro rakachinjika nehurefu. Ongorora zvakare kuti divi rinozivikanwa nedivi raunoda kuwana ndezvipi.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.explain: Hurefu hwepamusoro pemaziso i20×tan 35° ≈ 20×0.7002 ≈ 14.0 m, uye kuwedzera hurefu hwemaziso 1.5 m kunopa inenge 15.5 m.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.prompt: Chishandiso chekuyera kona yekusimudzira chine kukanganisa, saka kona chaiyo yekusimudzira inogona kuva 34° kana 36°. Kuverenga hurefu hwepamuti wefuremu kunochinja sei ipapo? Nyora uchishandisa nhamba imwe kana kupfuura, uye uwedzere mutsara mumwe wekuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini ne15.5 m. (Rejista: tan 34° ≈ 0.6745, tan 36° ≈ 0.7265)
y-m-30-02.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga nyaya dze34° ne36° nenzira imwe chete sekutanga.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa nekukosha kwe35° uye uongorore kuti vanosiyana zvakadini nekubvisa.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga nekuenzanisa hurefu pa34° ne36° zvakananga here?
y-m-30-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura nenhamba kuti hurefu hunochinja zvakadini kunyange kana kona yakakanganisa ne1° chete here?
y-m-30-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaedza kutaura mugumisiro sechiyero, sa 'pakati peinenge mamita akati nemamita akati' here?
y-m-30-02.s.s3.model.0: Pa34°, 20×0.6745+1.5≈15.0 m, uye pa36°, 20×0.7265+1.5≈16.0 m, saka kunyange kona yakakanganisa ne1° chete, hurefu hunochinja ne0.5 m inenge. Saka zvakanaka kuvimba ne15.5 m seinenge 15 kusvika 16 m.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.model.1: Kana yakayerwa se36°, inenge 16.0 m, uye kana yakayerwa se34°, inenge 15.0 m, saka pane musiyano une 1 m inenge. Zvakakosha kuyera kona yekusimudzira zvakanyatsonaka, uye 15.5 m kukosha kwakafungidzirwa.

y-m-30-06.title: Nzvimbo yekatatu rine mativi maviri 6 ne 10 inosarudzwa here?
y-m-30-06.topic: Nzvimbo yekatatu (mativi maviri nekona iri pakati pawo)
y-m-30-06.goal: Dzidza kuti kureba kwemativi maviri oga hakusarudzi nzvimbo yekatatu, paradzanisa ruzivo rwokuwedzera runorisarudza, uye utsanangure kuti pane makatatu ane nzvimbo imwe chete asi zvimiro zvakasiyana.
y-m-30-06.material: Mukatatu ABC, unongoziva kuti AB = 6 cm uye AC = 10 cm, uye hauzive hukuru hwe ∠A. Sezvo ikatatu, 0° < ∠A < 180°. Nzvimbo inogona kutsvakwa se ½ × AB × AC × sin A ('sin A' inoverengwa 'sine A'). Kukosha kwokureva: sin 30° = 1/2, sin 60° = (√3)/2 ≈ 0.866, sin 90° = 1, sin 150° = 1/2. Sine yekona yakapamhama yakaenzana nesine yekona yakapinza inowanikwa nokubvisa kona iyoyo kubva ku 180° (semuenzaniso, sin 150° = sin 30°).
y-m-30-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mhinduro dzose dzinosangana nemamiriro akafanana
y-m-30-06.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti zvimiro zvinosiyana kunyange nzvimbo yakafanana
y-m-30-06.prereq.0: Chirevo chenzvimbo yekatatu uchishandisa mativi maviri nesine yekona iri pakati pawo (½ × chakawanikwa chemativi maviri × sin(kona iri pakati))
y-m-30-06.prereq.1: Kukosha se sin 30°, sin 90°, sin 150° (chokwadi chokuti sine yekona yakapamhama yakaenzana nesine yekona yakapinza inowanikwa nokuibvisa kubva ku 180° chakapiwa mukanyorwa)
y-m-30-06.prereq.2: Mamiriro okufanana kwemakatatu (kana mativi matatu agadzirwa, katatu rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe)
y-m-30-06.s.s1.prompt: Pamusoro pa AB = 6 ne AC = 10, sarudza nyaya dzose umo nzvimbo yekatatu inosarudzwa kuva kukosha kumwe chete kana chimwe chezvinotevera chaziviswa.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pachimedu cheruzivo chega chega, verenga zvakasiyana kana katatu rimwe chete rinogona kugadzirwa kana akati wandei.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kune 'yakapinza', tsvaga kukosha kuviri kana kupfuura kunogoneka kwa ∠A uye uenzanise nzvimbo.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.a: Funga kana kukosha kwa sin A kunosiyana nenzira dzakati wandei kunyange mukati memhando yemakona akapinza.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.b: Funga kana katatu rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe kana mativi ose matatu asarudzwa.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.c: Funga kana, kana uchiziva kona iri pakati, unogona kutsvaga nzvimbo zvakananga nefomula.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.d: Funga kana ruzivo urwu runosarudza ∠A kuva kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.explain: Kana uchiziva kona iri pakati ∠A = 60°, nzvimbo inosarudzwa se ½×6×10×sin 60° = 15√3 ≈ 26.0 cm². Kana BC = 8, mativi matatu anosarudzwa saka katatu rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe (chaizvo 6, 8, 10 ikatatu rine kona yakarurama pa B, saka nzvimbo ndi ½×6×8 = 24 cm²), uye nzvimbo inosarudzwawo kuva kukosha kumwe chete. 'Yakapinza' kana 'haisi katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana' hazvisarudzi ∠A kuva kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.prompt: Kuti nzvimbo ive 15 cm² chaizvo, ∠A inofanira kuva ipi? Sarudza dzose dzinogoneka.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kune ∠A yega yega inogoneka, verenga kukosha kwa ½×6×10×sin A uye uienzanise ne 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wagadzirisa chirevo chenzvimbo ½×6×10×sin A = 15 sechirevo che sin A uye utsvage kukosha kwa sin A.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.a: Kana wakasatarisa kuti kukosha kwa sin ndekupi kunokona yakapamhama, uku kukosha kunonyanya kuvhiringidzwa.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.b: Kana ukaverenga nzvimbo yekona yakarurama zvakananga, unogona kutarisa kana inobuda 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.c: Uku kukosha kwawakatarisa nzvimbo uchishandisa sin 30° = 1/2.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.d: Kana ukaverenga nzvimbo nokukosha kwa sin 60°, unogona kutarisa kana inobuda 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.explain: Nzvimbo = ½×6×10×sin A = 30 sin A = 15 inopa sin A = 1/2. Pakati pe 0° ne 180°, pane makona maviri ane sin A = 1/2: 30° ne 150°. Pa 90° nzvimbo ndi 30, uye pa 60° ndi 26.0 kana zvakadaro.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.prompt: Makatatu maviri akagadzirwa nemakona maviri awakawana pa s2 ane AB = 6, AC = 10 uye ose ane nzvimbo ye 15 cm². Asi makatatu maviri haana chimiro chakafanana. Tsanangura nzira imwe kana kupfuura umo makatatu maviri anosiyana.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti divi ripi ndiro rakareba zvikuru mukatatu rega rega pamaviri.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tora AC sehwaro uye uenzanise kukwira kwakadhirowa kubva ku B munyaya mbiri.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura here nenhamba (kureba kwa BC, nezvimwewo) zvinosiyana pakati pemakatatu maviri?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaparadzanisa here chikonzero chokuti nzvimbo dzakaenzana (kukwira kwakafanana, kukosha kwa sin kwakafanana) nechikonzero chokuti zvimiro zvakasiyana?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti ndeipi pamaviri iri katatu rine kona yakapamhama?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.0: Kana ∠A=30°, ∠A yakapinza uye BC inenge 5.7 cm, asi pa 150° yakapamhama uye BC inenge 15.5 cm, refu zvikuru. Kunyange nzvimbo yakafanana, 15, chimiro chakasiyana.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.1: Mune zvose, kana ukatora AC sehwaro 10, kukwira kwakadhirowa kubva ku B kwakafanana, 3 cm, saka nzvimbo dzakaenzana. Asi pa 150°, B yakatsvedzera kunotambanudzwa kwa AC, saka chimiro chakasiyana.

y-m-30-01.title: Triangle ine mativi 8, 15, 17 iri right triangle here?
y-m-30-01.topic: Converse ye Pythagorean theorem nema right triangle ane hurefu hwemativi hwe natural number
y-m-30-01.goal: Tarisa kuti divi ripi rinotorwa sere refu zvikuru kana uchitarisa right triangle, tsvaga ma right triangle ane mativi e natural number erudzi rwakasiyana, uye utsanangure zvinoreva 'rudzi rumwe chete'.
y-m-30-01.material: Minseo akayera mativi matatu e triangle yekushongedza ndokuwana 8 cm, 15 cm, ne17 cm. Haana kuyera makona ipi neipi uye anoziva chete hurefu hwemativi matatu. Kuti atarise kuti triangle iyi iri right triangle, Minseo akaverenga seizvi pazasi. (Zvikamu zvose zvehurefu ndi cm. 8² inoverengwa se 'eight squared' uye 17² se 'seventeen squared'.)
y-m-30-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakawanda pasi pemiganhu (ma natural number, muganhu we hypotenuse, kubvisa kukudziridza)
y-m-30-01.prereq.1: Mu right triangle, hukama pakati pehuwandu hwema square emativi maviri ne square yedivi rasara, uye kuti converse yayo inoshanda (nhanho ye grade 9)
y-m-30-01.prereq.2: Ma divisor ne greatest common divisor
y-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe usina kururama mukuverenga kwaMinseo. Verenga nhamba dzemitsara kubva ku1.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ita kuverenga kwerudzi rumwe chete ne right triangle inozivikanwa 3, 4, 5. Kana ukatora 3 ne5 semativi anoita kona yakarurama uye ukaenzanisa 3²+5² ne4², chii chinoitika?
y-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mekutarisa kuti divi refu zvikuru pamativi matatu riri papi mu nyaya ye3, 4, 5, enzanisa kuti mativi maviri akasarudzwa naMinseo ari panzvimbo imwe chete here.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.line.1: Handizivi kuti divi ripi ndiro hypotenuse, saka ngatitorei 8 ne17 semativi maviri anoita kona yakarurama uye tiverenge.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.line.3: 353 ≠ 225, saka triangle iyi haisi right triangle.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiro dambudziko. Kana iri right triangle, divi riri pamberi pekona yakarurama (hypotenuse) ndiro refu zvikuru, saka divi refu zvikuru 17 rinofanira kuva divi rinoenzaniswa ne 'huwandu hwema square emativi mamwe maviri'. Kana ukatora 17 sedivi rinoita kona yakarurama ukaenzanisa, zvakaoma kuti ishande kune triangle ipi neipi. Saka mhedziso yemutsara 4 haigoni kuvimbwawo. Kuverenga zvakarurama, 8²+15²=64+225=289=17², saka iri right triangle.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma right triangle 3 erudzi rwakasiyana apo mativi ose matatu a, b, c ari ma natural number (c ndiyo hypotenuse). Mamiriro: hypotenuse c ndi30 kana pasi, uye greatest common divisor yemativi matatu ndi1. (Kunyora a ne b nenzira yakapesana kunopa triangle imwe chete.)
y-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga kubva ku 3, 4, 5 yatozivikanwa, uye chinja rimwe remativi maviri mapfupi kuti uone kuti divi rasara rinova natural number here.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kutanga tarisa kuti triangle yawakawana iri mune rondedzero yakakudziridzwa nehukama hwakafanana here, uye kuti mativi ose matatu anoparadzaniswa nenhamba imwe chete here.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Mativi ose matatu anofanira kuva ma natural number ari 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwema square emativi maviri hunoenzana ne square ye hypotenuse.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.fail.c2: a²+b² haienzani ne c². Tarisa zvakare kuti hypotenuse yakarurama here.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Hypotenuse c inofanira kuva 30 kana pasi.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Greatest common divisor yemativi matatu ndi1.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Mativi matatu ane common divisor huru kupfuura 1. Inogona kuva kukudziridzwa kwe triangle diki.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: Ma triangle anogutsa mamiriro ndiwo mashanu chete (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), (7, 24, 25), (20, 21, 29) (unogona kuatarisa zvakananga). (6, 8, 10) yabviswa nekuti greatest common divisor ndi2.
y-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora nemashoko ako kuti nei (6, 8, 10) isingaverengwi se 'triangle itsva' yakasiyana ne (3, 4, 5).
y-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: Batanidza hurefu hwemativi unoenderana ematriangle maviri imwe neimwe uye unyore kana pane hukama hwekugovanisa kana kuwanza.
y-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti ndechipi chakachinja, 'hukuru' kana 'chimiro'.
y-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza hukama pakati pe3, 4, 5 ne6, 8, 10 nenhamba here?
y-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa kuti 'chimiro' ne 'hukuru' kupi kwakafanana uye kupi kwakasiyana here?
y-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti mativi ose matatu akakura neratio imwe chete here?
y-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: 6, 8, 10 i3, 4, 5 imwe neimwe yakawanzwa ne2, saka itriangle ine chimiro chakafanana. Hukuru chete hwakasiyana, saka handina kuiverenga serudzi rutsva.
y-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Mativi ose matatu ndiwo mamultiples akafanana e3, 4, 5, saka kukura kwetriangle ye3, 4, 5 (similar triangle). Saka ndakaiverenga serudzi rumwe chete.

y-m-30-03.title: Kufungidzira daro kubva papoinzi iri kunze kwedenderedzwa kusvika papoinzi yekubata
y-m-30-03.topic: Hukama pakati petangent yedenderedzwa neradius yaro
y-m-30-03.goal: Famba nemuitiro umo kureba kwetangent, kwaigona kupiwa sechiyero chete pakutanga, kunosarudzwa kana ruzivo rwekuti tangent iperpendicular neradius rwawedzerwa, uye utonge kana kufunga kwakafanana kuchishanda kutangent yechipiri.
y-m-30-03.material: Pane denderedzwa O rine radius 5 cm. Kubva papoinzi P iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, dhirowa tangent kudenderedzwa, uye rudaidza poinzi yekubata A. Daro kubva pakati O kusvika papoinzi P i13 cm. Unoda kuwana kureba kwetangent PA. (Hapana mufananidzo. Fungidzira triangle ine mapoinzi matatu O, A, P semakona ayo.)
y-m-30-03.thinking.0: Kuona kuti chiyero nekuvimba kwekutonga zvinochinja sei sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera
y-m-30-03.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa kuverenga kwepfungwa (13 − 5) nekuverenga kune hwaro
y-m-30-03.thinking.2: Kutonga kana zvakanaka kuwedzera kunyaya imwe ine chimiro chakafanana
y-m-30-03.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pehuwandu hwehurefu hwemativi maviri etriangle nehurefu hwedivi rakasara
y-m-30-03.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti tangent yedenderedzwa iperpendicular neradius kuburikidza nepoinzi yekubata (inoonekwa seruzivo rutsva panhanho 3)
y-m-30-03.prereq.2: Hukama pakati pemativi matatu etriangle yakarurama
y-m-30-03.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Tonga uchishandisa ruzivo kusvika panhanho iyoyo chete, uye unogona kugadzirisa kutonga kwako mushure mekuona ruzivo runotevera.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe 'zvakaratidzwa nyowani', wobva wasarudza.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko hukama huripo pakati pehurefu hwemativi matatu etriangle yakagadzirwa nemapoinzi matatu O, A ne P.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvaunoziva zvino: OA = 5 cm (radius), OP = 13 cm. Poinzi A ipoinzi iri padenderedzwa uye PA itangent yedenderedzwa iri. Usashandise hunhu hwematangent zvino.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana O, A, P zvisiri pamutsetse mumwe, triangle OAP inogadzirwa. Mutriangle, huwandu hwemativi maviri huri huru kupfuura divi rakasara, saka PA iri huru kupfuura 13 − 5 = 8 uye iri pasi pe13 + 5 = 18. 8 idaro rakapfupika zvikuru kubva papoinzi P kusvika padenderedzwa, uye hairi kureba kwetangent. Zvino unogona kutaura chiyero chete.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Pangava pawakasanganisa daro rakapfupika zvikuru kubva papoinzi P kusvika padenderedzwa nekureba kwetangent. Fungidzira kana poinzi A iri nzvimbo inoita daro iri.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yakareba kupfuura 8 cm uye yakapfupika kupfuura 18 cm
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakanyatsotorwa kubva pachiyero chehurefu kubva pachokwadi chekuti mapoinzi matatu anogadzira triangle.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Fungidzira kana pane chikonzero chekutora OP nePA sehurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kukosha hakugoni kusarudzwa neruzivo urwu chete
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakangwarira kunofunga kuti kukosha chaiko hakusati kwasarudzwa.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rutsva: tangent iperpendicular neradius kuburikidza nepoinzi yekubata. Ndiko kuti, OA ⊥ PA (zvidimbu zviviri zvinogadzira kona yakarurama).
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchifunga ruzivo urwu, unogona kutaura chii nezvePA?
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Triangle OAP itriangle yakarurama ine kona yakarurama paA uye hypotenuse yayo i OP. Saka PA² = 13² − 5² = 144, uye PA = 12 cm. 12 iri pakati pe8 ne18, saka kutonga kwekutanga kwechiyero hakuna kukanganisa, uye ruzivo rutsva rwakapfupisa chiyero ichocho kuita kukosha kumwe.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kutonga kwekutanga sezvakaita: yakareba kupfuura 8 cm uye yakapfupika kupfuura 18 cm
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kutonga kwechiyero kuchiri kwechokwadi. Asi fungidzira kana kungapfupiswazve neruzivo rutsva.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Pangava pawakawedzera masquare maviri usina kuongorora kana OP idivi rinogadzira kona yakarurama kana hypotenuse.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Pangava pawakachengeta 8 usina kushandisa ruzivo rwekuti tangent iperpendicular neradius.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kukosha kwakashandisa poinzi yekuti hypotenuse mutriangle yakarurama OAP i OP.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Dhirowa imwe tangent kubva papoinzi P kudenderedzwa uye rudaidza poinzi yekubata B (B ipoinzi yakasiyana neA). Minjun anoti, 'PB i12 cm futi,' uye Seoa anoti, 'B ipoinzi yakasiyana neA, saka PB inogona kusava 12.'
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Mutriangle OBP futi, OB = 5 (radius), OP = 13, uye kona paB irakarurama, saka PB² = 169 − 25 = 144, uye PB = 12 cm. Chokwadi chekuti poinzi yekubata yakasiyana chakachinja, asi mamiriro anosarudza kureba (radius 5, daro kuenda pakati 13, kona yakarurama) akafanana, saka kukosha kwakafanana.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Chirevo chaSeoa chakakodzera. Kana poinzi yekubata yakasiyana, kureba kunogona kusiyanawo
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku kunzwa kwekuti kana poinzi yekubata ichichinja, kukosha kuchachinjawo. Fungidzira kuti chii chiri kuchinja chaizvo.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hapana ruzivo, saka hapana chirevo chinogona kutongwa
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakafunga kuti hapana ruzivo rwakawedzerwa nyowani. Fungidzira kana pane kukosha kunozivikanwa mutriangle OBP.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Chirevo chaMinjun chakakodzera. Triangle OBP ine mamiriro akafanana
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakapa chikonzero chekuti matriangle maviri ane mamiriro akafanana.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Matangent maviri ane kureba kwakafanana, asi unofanira kudhirowa mufananidzo kuti uve nechokwadi
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Mhedziso yakafanana, asi fungidzira kana mufananidzo uchidiwa chaizvo.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.reflect: Panhanho 1 waigona kutaura chiyero chete, uye ruzivo rutsva rwenhanho 2 rwakasarudza kukosha. Siyanisa kana kutonga kwekutanga kwechiyero kwakava 'kusina kururama' nokuda kweruzivo rutsva kana kwakapfupiswa. Tarisawo shure kana panhanho 3 wakatonga uchiparadzanisa zvakachinja (poinzi yekubata) nezvisina kuchinja (mamiriro anosarudza kureba).
y-m-30-03.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yakati, 'PA i13 − 5 = 8 cm.' Tsanangurira shamwari iyi, uchishandisa nhamba, kuti nei 8 cm isiri kureba kwetangent.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.hint.0: Taura kuti 8 cm ikureba kwechii, uchishandisa hukama hwenzvimbo pakati pepoinzi P nedenderedzwa.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora maitiro ekuwana PA uchishandisa hunhu hwematangent nechimiro chetriangle OAP.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti kukosha 8 kunomirira chii (daro rakapfupika zvikuru kubva paP kusvika padenderedzwa) here?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura chimiro chetriangle chinosarudza kureba kwetangent here?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaratidza maitiro anoita kuti nhamba yandakasarudza ive 12 chaizvo here?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.0: 13−5=8 idaro riri padhuze zvikuru kubva papoinzi P kusvika padenderedzwa. Tangent PA iperpendicular neradius OA, saka triangle OAP itriangle yakarurama uye hypotenuse yayo i OP=13, saka PA=12 cm.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.1: PA inofanira kuva yakareba kupfuura 8. Mutriangle OAP, kuwedzera 5 ne8 kunopa 13, saka triangle haigadzirwi. Mutriangle yakarurama, 13 idivi refu zvikuru, saka inova 12.

y-m-30-07.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pemativi matatu etriangle yakarurama
y-m-30-07.title: Chinhambwe pakati pemachord maviri anofanana chinosarudzwa kuva kukosha kumwe here?
y-m-30-07.goal: Tsvaga chinhambwe kubva pakati kuenda kuchord, uye utonge uye unyore kuti mhinduro yakakwana chete kana wafunga nyaya yokuti machord maviri anofanana ari padivi rimwe repakati nenyaya yokuti ari kumativi akasiyana.
y-m-30-07.material: Mudenderedzwa O rine radius 13 cm, pane chord AB yakareba 24 cm nachord CD yakareba 10 cm. Machord maviri anofanana. Hapana mufananidzo unopiwa. Unoda kutsvaga chinhambwe pakati pemachord maviri. (Mutsetse wakananga wakadhirowa kubva pakati pedenderedzwa kuenda kuchord unoparadzanisa chord iyoyo kuva hafu.)
y-m-30-07.thinking.1: Kutsvaga pfungwa yakaiswa pasina kutaurwa mumhinduro
y-m-30-07.thinking.2: Kunyora mhinduro inoenderana nemamiriro (kuparadzanisa kuva nyaya)
y-m-30-07.prereq.0: Chokwadi chokuti mutsetse wakananga wakadhirowa kubva pakati pedenderedzwa kuenda kuchord unoparadzanisa chord iyoyo kuva hafu
y-m-30-07.s.s1.prompt: Chord yega yega iri kure zvakadini kubva pakati O kwedenderedzwa?
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura nemashoko katatu rine mapoinzi ari chigunwe chomutsetse wakananga, mugumo mumwe wechord, nepakati O, uye utsvage kona yakarurama iri kupi.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mokusarudza kuti divi ripi rekatatu iroro ndiro rakareba zvikuru, nyora chirevo chinotsvaga divi rasara kubva pakureba kuviri kunozikanwa.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.a: 12 cm kuna AB, 5 cm kuna CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.a: Unogona kunge wakafunga kuti chord yakareba kupfuura, iri kure nepakati. Gadzira katatu rine kona yakarurama nehafu yechord neradius kuti utarise.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.b: 1 cm kuna AB, 8 cm kuna CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.b: Unogona kunge wakazviwana nokubvisa hafu yechord kubva paradius. Tarisa kuti divi ripi ihypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.c: 5 cm kuna AB, 12 cm kuna CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.c: Uku kukosha kwakashandisa chokwadi chokuti mutsetse wakananga kubva pakati kuenda kuchord unopfuura napakati pechord.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.d: √313 cm kuna AB, √194 cm kuna CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kunge wakawedzera sikweya yehafu yechord kusikweya yeradius. Tarisa kuti divi ripi ihypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.explain: Chigunwe chomutsetse wakananga kubva ku O kuenda ku AB ipakati pa AB, uye mukatatu rine kona yakarurama rinogadzirwa nehafu yokureba 12 neradius 13, chinhambwe ndi √(13² − 12²) = 5. Kuna CD, hafu yokureba ndi 5, saka √(13² − 5²) = 12. Chord yakareba kupfuura, iri padhuze nepakati.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.prompt: Pazasi pane mhinduro yakawana chinhambwe pakati pemachord maviri. Sarudza mutsetse une pfungwa yakaiswa pasina chikonzero. Verenga nhamba dzemitsetse kubva pa 1.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.0: Isa imwe ye zvinotevera pamberi pomutsetse wega wega: 'yakanyorwa mudambudziko / yakabuda mukuverenga / mugadziri wemhinduro akaisarudza.'
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana paine mutsetse wakasarudzwa nomugadziri wemhinduro, yedza kuti mhedzisiro yaizochinja sei dai yakasarudzwa zvakasiyana.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.0: Chinhambwe kubva pakati O kuenda ku AB ndi 5 cm, uye chinhambwe kuenda ku CD ndi 12 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.1: Machord maviri anofanana, saka mitsetse yakananga kubva ku O kuenda kumachord maviri iri pamutsetse mumwe.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.2: Machord ose mbiri ari padivi rimwe re O.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.3: Saka chinhambwe pakati pemachord maviri ndi 12 − 5 = 7 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo une dambudziko. Dambudziko harina mamiriro okuti machord maviri ari padivi rimwe re O, asi mhinduro yakasarudza izvozvo. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 mhedziso inotevera pfungwa iyoyo, saka mutsetse une pfungwa yakaiswa pasina hwaro ndimutsetse 3. Mitsetse 1 ne 2 yakarurama.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.prompt: Dhirowa nyaya apo machord maviri ari kumativi akasiyana epakati O. Tsvaga chinhambwe panguva iyoyo, uye unyore kuti mhinduro yedambudziko iri inofanira kunyorwa sei.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.0: Chinja pfungwa iri pamutsetse 3 wemhinduro uye udhirowe machord maviri kumativi akasiyana e O.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.1: Munyaya iyoyo, nyora nemashoko kuti ungabatanidza sei zvinhambwe 5 ne 12 kubva ku O kuenda kumachord maviri kuti uwane chinhambwe pakati pemachord maviri.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti wakawana sei chinhambwe chemativi akasiyana (wakabatanidza sei 5 ne 12)?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here divi rimwe (7 cm) nedivi rakasiyana (17 cm) semhinduro?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here chikonzero chokuti pasina mufananidzo nzvimbo hadzisarudzwi?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.0: Kana ari kumativi akasiyana, ndi 5+12=17 cm. Saka kana machord maviri ari padivi rimwe re O ndi 7 cm, uye kana ari kumativi akasiyana ndi 17 cm, uye sezvo pasina mufananidzo, nyaya dzose mbiri, 7 cm kana 17 cm, mhinduro.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.1: Kana O iri pakati pawo, wedzera 5 ne 12 kuti uwane 17 cm. Kana ari padivi rimwe, 7 cm. Dambudziko harina mamiriro enzvimbo, saka ndinofanira kunyora kuti pane mhinduro mbiri (7 cm, 17 cm).

y-m-30-08.title: Tsvimbo refu zvikuru inokwana mubhokisi
y-m-30-08.topic: Diagonali yebhokisi rakareba (kushandisa dzidziso yaPythagoras mudimension nhatu)
y-m-30-08.goal: Kana uchitsvaga kureba kwechikamu chomutsetse mushape yakasimba, shandisa chokwadi chokuti diagonali yepasi nokukwira zvinogadzira kona yakarurama, gadzira mabhokisi umo kureba kwediagonali kuri nhamba yechisikigo nenzira dzakati wandei, uye utonge kana tsvimbo inokwana.
y-m-30-08.material: Pane bhokisi risina chinhu rakareba rakafara 3 cm, rakadzika 4 cm, uye rakakwira 12 cm. Unoda kuisa tsvimbo yakatetepa zvikuru isingakotami yose mukati mebhokisi iri. Regedza ukobvu hwebhokisi, uye fungidzira kuti mipimo yomukati yakafanana neyokunze. Unoda kutsvaga kureba kwetsvimbo refu zvikuru inogona kukwana mukati mebhokisi.
y-m-30-08.thinking.0: Kutsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro ine kukanganisa
y-m-30-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira mabhokisi akati wandei anosangana nemipimo
y-m-30-08.prereq.1: Hukama hwenzvimbo hwemicheto nenzvimbo dzakatsetseka dzebhokisi rakareba (pasi nokukwira zvakananga)
y-m-30-08.s.s1.prompt: Pazasi pane mhinduro apo mudzidzi akawana kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakaipa. Verenga nhamba dzemitsetse kubva ku 1.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura mumashoko kuti banhu rinorara sei rakarerekera kubva kudivi rimwe rebhokisi kuenda kudivi rakatarisana repamusoro, uye utarise kuti 5 ne 12 zvemutsetse 3 zvinoita angle ipi pakati pazvo.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa triangle inoumbwa nezvikamu zviviri zve 5 cm ne 12 cm nebanhu. Tarisa uchishandisa hukama pakati pemativi etriangle kana kureba kwemativi matatu kuchigona kuva 5, 12, 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.1: Kureba kwe diagonal yepasi i 3² + 4² = 25, saka i 5.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.2: Banhu rinorara muchimiro chinobatanidza diagonal yepasi 5 nekukwirira 12, saka 5 + 12 = 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.3: Saka banhu refu zvikuru i 17 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiro dambudziko. Banhu rinopfuura rakarerekera kubva pakona yepasi kuenda pakona yakatarisana yepamusoro, saka diagonal yepasi (5) nekukwirira (12) zvakagadzikana, uye banhu i hypotenuse ye right triangle ine zviviri izvi semativi. Hypotenuse haisi huwandu hwemativi maviri asi square root yehuwandu hwema squares awo, saka i pfupi. Saka 17 cm yemutsetse 4 yakaipawo. Kana ukaverenga zvakarurama, √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pemabhokisi e rectangular ane upamhi a, kudzika b, nekukwirira c zvese i natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12, gadzira mabhokisi 3 akasiyana apo kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru rinopinda mukati zvakare i natural number. (Mabhokisi ane a, b, c munhevedzano yakasiyana chete i bhokisi rimwechete.)
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza hurefu huviri pa hutatu uye uwane square ye diagonal yepasi, wobva wachinja kukwirira uye utarise kana huwandu hwose huchiva square yenhamba imwe.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mabhokisi awakawana neyekutanga 3, 4, 12, uye uedze nenhevedzano uchitanga nenhamba shoma nenzira imwechete.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Hurefu hutatu i natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Upamhi, kudzika, nekukwirira zvinofanira kuva natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru i natural number.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru (square root yehuwandu hwema squares ehurefu hutatu) hakusi natural number.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (1, 2, 2) inopa √9 = 3, (2, 3, 6) inopa √49 = 7, (4, 4, 7) inopa √81 = 9, uye (2, 4, 4) inopa √36 = 6. Bhokisi rekutanga (3, 4, 12) rinopa √169 = 13, saka i rimwe rembhokisi dzinogutsa mamiriro aya.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.prompt: Waisa banhu mubhokisi rine upamhi 3, kudzika 4, nekukwirira 12. Hukama hwakakodzera pakati pekureba kwebanhu nebhokisi i hupi? (13 cm i kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru.)
y-m-30-08.s.s3.hint.0: Neba nhu re 13 cm rakarara padiagonal, tsanangura mumashoko kuti kureba kwaro kunochinja sei kana ukafambisa kumucheto kumwe zvishoma kuenda mukati.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, ita tebhura uchipatsanura kuita kana banhu rakareba kupfuura 13, kana i 13, uye kana i pfupi kupfuura 13.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.a: Banhu re 13.1 cm rinopindawo kana ukarivata rakarerekera
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.a: Funga kana banhu rakareba kupfuura kureba kwebanhu refu zvikuru rigona kupinda.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.b: Mabanhu ese akareba kupfuura 12 cm haapindi
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.b: Ungangodaro wakatora 12 semuganhu nekuti kukwirira ndiko edge refu zvikuru. Funga kana chikamu chakarerekera chingagona kuva chakareba kupfuura edge.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.c: Mabanhu ese e 13 cm kana kushoma anopinda uye 13.1 cm haipindi
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.c: Uku i kutonga kwakafunga pamwe chete kureba kwechikamu chakareba zvikuru nekana mabanhu mapfupi kupfuura iro achipinda.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.d: Banhu re 13 cm chete rinopinda uye banhu re 12.8 cm haripindi
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.d: Ungangodaro wakafunga kuti banhu rakapfupika rinogona kusaiswa. Funga kuti zvinoitika kana ukafambisa kumucheto kumwe kwebanhu.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.explain: Chikamu chakareba zvikuru chinogona kuiswa mukati mebhokisi i 13 cm (diagonal), saka mabanhu ese e 13 cm kana kushoma anogona kuiswa, uye banhu re 13.1 cm haripindi. Banhu rakareba kupfuura 12 cm rinogonawo kupinda kana rakavatwa rakarerekera.
